body:

I was ban for Void-Loggin, is my first ban and I will play a scrimmage with my team, but I can´t.

I wanna be unbaned, if it's posible, to play this.

I promise you, I will never do Void-Loggin again, please.

title: Temp-Ban Appeal [Firebonezz]

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hey Firebonezz,

Unfortunately, I cannot accept your appeal because you have been validly banned. However, your ban time is only one day, and you will be able to access the server soon. Hopefully, you'll be able to play in the next scrim.

Regards,
Rinn | Senior Moderator
